# GraphEvent

`schemas/records/graph-event.json`

The payload of every artifact-graph event (docs/design/m0/13), discriminated by type: node.recorded/v1, node.claimed/v1, node.reused/v1, node.reuse_released/v1, node.invalidated/v1, node.hold_raised/v1, node.hold_paged/v1 and node.hold_cleared/v1 under the node's id, result.recorded/v1 and result.selected/v1 under the result's id; each in the node's project. internal/graph folds them into the graph projections in the writer transaction and refuses one its state does not derive.

A document is one of: [NodeRecorded](#noderecorded) or [NodeClaimed](#nodeclaimed) or [NodeInvalidated](#nodeinvalidated) or [NodeReused](#nodereused) or [NodeReuseReleased](#nodereusereleased) or [HoldRaised](#holdraised) or [HoldPaged](#holdpaged) or [HoldCleared](#holdcleared) or [ResultRecorded](#resultrecorded) or [ResultSelected](#resultselected).

## Definitions

### NodeRecorded

A node joins its task's graph, append-only: its task, its project and the node it succeeds (null for a first round).

#### Fields of NodeRecorded

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_recorded` |  |
| `node` | yes | [node](records-node.md) |  |
| `task` | yes | [TaskID](common-defs.md#taskid) |  |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `predecessor` | yes | null or [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeClaimed

A node's claim on its computation key (13 [G10]): its inputs as they resolved, fixed from here on, and the key they give. A claim is a node instance's: a repeat demand of the node joins it and records nothing; a memoizable kind's key is claimed once per task.

#### Fields of NodeClaimed

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_claimed` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |
| `inputs` | yes | array of [ClaimedInput](#claimedinput) | Each declared input and what it resolved to, in declared order: a result, or an approval with its revision. A new kind of resolution is a new event version (node.claimed/v2), since every field is required. |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeInvalidated

An explicit, recorded invalidation (13 [G1]): the node's claim moves to the next generation, with the same inputs, so its key changes and its selected result, if any, no longer answers it.

#### Fields of NodeInvalidated

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_invalidated` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeReused

A memoizable instance refused a claim because another node of its task holds its key completes by reuse (13 [G10]): the holder's selected result at the current generation, same task, kind and key. inputs are the instance's own resolved inputs. It never claims and never runs, and is never invalidated on its own: the holder's invalidation releases it (node.reuse_released).

#### Fields of NodeReused

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_reused` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `holder` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |
| `inputs` | yes | array of [ClaimedInput](#claimedinput) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeReuseReleased

The holder of key was invalidated, and the node bound to key by reuse is released in the same command (13 [G1]): its reuse and its result are dropped, and it waits for its inputs again, to reuse or claim at the new generation.

#### Fields of NodeReuseReleased

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_reuse_released` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldRaised

An external wait on the node (02 "Hold reasons and resume signals"): raised at the event's time with no page yet. result is set exactly when the hold has a reason: it is the retry wait of the node's could_not_run result of its current key (13 [G2]), one hold per result.

#### Fields of HoldRaised

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `hold_raised` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `hold` | yes | [node-hold](records-node-hold.md) |  |
| `result` | yes | null or [ResultID](common-defs.md#resultid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldPaged

A page of the hold at the event's time, for its signal instance, once per owner and owner_ref: the fold refuses a repeated (owner, owner_ref), and the pager must not retry it (02: by hold id and signal instance). The owner's first page may come at once; page_after times only the escalation, from which on a page may go to the recorded escalate_to, which then owns the hold.

#### Fields of HoldPaged

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `hold_paged` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `hold` | yes | [HoldID](common-defs.md#holdid) |  |
| `owner` | yes | [Owner](vocab-registry.md#owner) |  |
| `owner_ref` | yes | null or string (minLength `1`, maxLength `256`) |  |
| `channel` | yes | null or [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldCleared

The hold leaves the node, with its cause: its signal arrived (the hold's signal instance), or it was retired with a reason (invalidated: a retry wait of an old key). Hold transfer to a replacement is G6b's supersession, in one transaction with it.

#### Fields of HoldCleared

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `hold_cleared` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `hold` | yes | [HoldID](common-defs.md#holdid) |  |
| `cause` | yes | [Signalled](#signalled) or [Retired](#retired) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### ResultSelected

The node selects its result: a completed result that is not could_not_run (13 [G2]), answering the node's current key, once per claim.
